## SECTION 3: SPECIALIZED SERVICES (SAMStack Studio)

### 3.1 — Full-Stack Web Development (MERN & Next.js)
Enterprise-grade web applications utilizing Next.js App Router for maximum SEO dominance, sub-second load times, and high conversion rates. Robust backend engineering with MongoDB, Node.js, Express.js, or Laravel (PHP). B2B SaaS platforms, customer portals, and real-time dashboards.

### 3.2 — Mobile App Development (Flutter for iOS & Android)
Cross-platform native mobile applications built with Flutter and Dart. Features offline-first architecture, push notifications (FCM), Google Maps geolocation, and payment gateways (JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Stripe).

### 3.3 — Desktop Application Development (Electron.js)
Offline-first desktop software for Windows, macOS, and Linux built using Electron.js and React.js. Specialization in Point of Sale (POS) retail software, warehouse inventory systems, factory production ERPs, and hardware peripheral integration (thermal printers, barcode scanners).

### 3.4 — Automation Development & Python Scripting
Automating complex repetitive workflows, business data synchronization, and data harvesting:
- Stealth web scraping via Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium.
- Interactive WhatsApp Business bots, Telegram bots, and Discord integrations.
- Scheduled cloud cron pipelines syncing Google Sheets, CRM systems, and accounting tools.

### 3.5 — AI Solutions & LLM Integrations
Building production Generative AI applications:
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge-base assistants trained on proprietary corporate documents.
- Autonomous multi-step AI agents powered by OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude.
- Conversational customer support chatbots integrated into websites and WhatsApp.

### 3.6 — Data Analysis & Business Intelligence
Transforming raw transactional and behavioral data into actionable growth strategies using Python, SQL, and interactive Power BI dashboards.

### 3.7 — High-Level SEO, GEO & AEO Services
Technical SEO, Local SEO for Lahore and Pakistan, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensuring top rankings in AI search results (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini), and JSON-LD Knowledge Graph entity schemas.
